title: Stakeholder Analysis & Management
description: Identify, map, and manage stakeholder relationships. Tests power/interest mapping, comms planning, and resistance management.

seo.overviewBody: Stakeholder management aligns project goals with key organizational influencers. BAs demonstrate leadership by mapping stakeholders on Mendelow's Power-Interest Grid (Manage Closely, Keep Satisfied, Keep Informed, Monitor), developing communication plans, and managing conflicting priorities.

deliverables.title: 1. Stakeholder Power-Interest Matrix & Grid
deliverables.desc: Mendelow’s Power-Interest grid categorizing project stakeholders by influence and interest levels.

deliverables.title: 2. Stakeholder Communication & Engagement Plan
deliverables.desc: Communication matrix specifying update channels, reporting frequencies, and tailored messaging strategies.

deliverables.title: 3. Stakeholder Conflict Resolution Log
deliverables.desc: Documentation logging conflicting stakeholder requirements, negotiation trade-offs, and consensus agreements.

faqs.question: How do you manage stakeholders in Mendelow’s 'High Power / Low Interest' quadrant?
faqs.answer: Keep Satisfied: Engage them sufficiently to ensure their needs are met without overwhelming them with operational details, as they possess authority to block projects.

faqs.question: How do you handle conflicting requirements between two senior stakeholders?
faqs.answer: Facilitate a structured alignment workshop, present data-driven trade-off analysis tied to strategic business goals, and escalate to the project sponsor if consensus cannot be reached.

faqs.question: Why is stakeholder analysis conducted early in the project lifecycle?
faqs.answer: Early analysis identifies key decision-makers, uncovers hidden opposition, and aligns expectations before requirements are finalized.
